notes: Both styles are fully text-verified (year = 1st & 2nd digits, month = 3rd & 4th digits) with no chart dependency. Style 2 sample 850304091 matches Bryant style-2 in shape and rule, but the page does not establish a shared system with Bryant, so no sister/useStylesOf claim is made.

styles.notes: Page 1-based positions 1-2 = year, 3-4 = month (page marks the prefix 0004), converted to 0-based half-open ranges. Year 00 resolves to 2000 under the century rule (1900 is below the 1960 floor). The page prints the trailing sequence as both 0099 and 00999, so the pattern covers 17-18 normalized digits and both printed variants are carried as examples; the trailing digits are sequence only and do not affect the decode.
